newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TriMas estimates cut. [CORRECTED 18:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TriMas estimates cut. [CORRECTED 18:15 GMT]

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said on Wednesday it has a downward bias on its third quarter estimate of $0.38 a share, compared with $0.34 a year ago, (corrects from "cut its third quarter estimate for TriMas Corp to $0.34 a share from $0.38").
-- It added its estimate of an 11 percent revenue increase could prove conservative given recent contribution from acquisitions.
-- The full year estimate remains $1.57 a share.
-- TriMas makes diversified proprietary products in the consumer, industrial and commercial niche markets.
